description: The firm's product record. publish_source gives an app a url and bearer to POST events; record writes one; query runs a read by name (a metric_queries row) with its params on the firm's calendar.

op.description: publish_source | unpublish_source | list_sources: the apps that may POST. record: one event now. query: a read by name. pin: keep a query in front of you every turn (pinned true), or stop (false).

caller.description: publish_source / unpublish_source: who the bearer is for, e.g. 'website' or 'pos'. Publishing again for the same caller rotates the token.

event.description: record: the event name, <resource>.<action_past>, e.g. member.checked_in. Read metric_events for the vocabulary before naming a new one.

subject_id.description: record: who or what took the step — a contact_id, a device, an account. The firm's own id.

at.description: record: when, ISO 8601. Omit for now.

properties.description: record: flat scalars that ride along, e.g. {"plan": "monthly", "location": "pier"}.

name.description: query, pin: the query's name — a metric_queries row of this firm's, or a canonical one (active, count, count_by, funnel_3, retention), copied in on first use. No inline SQL: save one with write_schema op=extend, then call it.

params.description: query: the row's parameters by name, e.g. {"event": "member.checked_in", "grain": "week"}. start, end, zone and grain are filled from the window when omitted.

window.description: query: today | this_week | this_month | last_month | this_year | last_7_days | last_30_days | last_90_days, on the firm's calendar. Default this_month. Or set start and end.

start.description: query: window start, ISO date or datetime in the firm's zone. With end, replaces window.

end.description: query: window end, exclusive, ISO date or datetime in the firm's zone.

pinned.description: pin: true to keep the query in every turn's prompt, false to stop. Default true.
